subject: Proposed tiered-fee revision & SOW edit for CloudTau pilot
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sierra Holt <sierra.holt@cloudtau.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed tiered-fee revision & SOW edit for CloudTau pilot

Hi Sierra —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our product/ops review, the pilot is tracking higher for short, bursty inference (low-latency) than we originally modeled. To keep the pilot commercially viable for both sides, I attached a small proposal: a tiered-fee schedule (Fee_Tier_Proposed.xlsx) plus a short SOW edit that moves 20% of expected token volume into an on-demand overage tier rather than the committed slab.

Key asks:
- Can CloudTau accept a tiered-fee structure for months 2–6 of the pilot (details in the XLSX)?
- If yes, we need a quick SOW edit to reflect the change and the acceptance criteria for throughput that triggers the overage band.

I copied Laura and Karthik to coordinate the legal routing and pricing approval. Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.docx (clean SOW), Fee_Tier_Proposed.xlsx.

If that works, I can route a redline and ask for a 72-hour review from CloudTau legal to keep us on schedule for the planned October pilot ramp.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198

---

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOW_v2.docx (docx), Fee_Tier_Proposed.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sierra Holt <sierra.holt@cloudtau.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Ops <eng-legal@cloudtau.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed tiered-fee revision & SOW edit for CloudTau pilot

Vivek —

Appreciate the context and attachments. Two quick clarifying items from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether the overage tier is capped at a monthly percentage (e.g., max 30% of committed tokens) or truly unbounded? Our procurement team prefers a soft cap to avoid runaway spend during trials.
2) The SOW version you attached looks like the clean copy; can you send a redline with the proposed insertion stanzas so our legal can see exact language? A PDF with inline comments is easiest.

I copied our engineering-legal alias to keep them in the loop. If you can get that redline to us by EOD Thursday we’ll aim for a one-business-day turnaround on contract comments.

Thanks —
Sierra Holt
Head of Cloud Platforms | CloudTau
sierra.holt@cloudtau.com

---

Note: CloudTau asked for an explicit cap; they want to avoid unlimited overage exposure for the pilot.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed tiered-fee revision & SOW edit for CloudTau pilot

Laura —

Forwarding Sierra's reply. Vivek, I pulled together a quick redline and added a short clause that caps overage at 30% of committed tokens per month during the pilot and describes the emergency spike protection (auto-throttle + pre-approval for anything above cap). Redline attached as SOW_redline_comments.pdf and I updated the pricing XLSX to show the cap's impact on projected ARR.

Notes for legal review:
- The cap is timebound to pilot months 2–6; after that we'll move to a committed+burst negotiation.
- We intentionally kept the acceptance criteria narrow: 99th percentile p95 latency under 350ms for calls under 4k tokens.

Can you please:
1) Do a legal sanity check on the phrasing in SOW_redline_comments.pdf.
2) Confirm whether commercial counsel needs additional language for indemnity or a separate addendum.

I can take point on commercial chat with Sierra after legal OKs.

—Karthik
Principal Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: SOW_redline_comments.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed tiered-fee revision & SOW edit for CloudTau pilot

Karthik / Vivek —

Quick read through the redline and pricing impact. High level: the 30% soft cap during months 2–6 is commercially reasonable for a pilot. A few legal points to tighten before routing to CloudTau legal:

1) Define "committed tokens" precisely (we should reference the Order Form exhibit ID and the measurement window "monthly UTC calendar month").
2) Replace the phrase "emergency spike protection" with concrete operational steps (e.g., "automatic throttle to 50% of baseline, notification to customer, and manual escalation within 1 hour").
3) Add a short carve-out that pilot overages waived if caused by Redwood platform bug (with logging evidence).
4) Keep indemnity language unchanged; no additional indemnity addendum needed for this scope, per counsel.

I suggest we produce a two-page cover memo summarizing changes for CloudTau legal (bullet list + redline PDF) to speed their review and reduce rounds. I can draft that and propose a 72-hour review SLA in the memo.

If you want me to send to CloudTau legal, give me the final redline & I will route with the memo + HubSpot deal link.

—Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

---

Legal action items listed; Laura will take point on memo and routing once redline is final.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sierra Holt <sierra.holt@cloudtau.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed tiered-fee revision & SOW edit for CloudTau pilot

Sierra —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per Laura's notes, I've updated the SOW redline (attached) to:
- Define committed tokens and the monthly UTC measurement window,
- Replace the "emergency spike protection" placeholder with explicit throttle/notification/escalation steps,
- Add the platform-bug overage carve-out.

Laura will send a one-page cover memo and route the documents to your legal alias with a 72-hour review request. If that timeline works for you, I'll prepare the DocuSign packet after you signal acceptance of the redline language.

Next steps:
- Laura to route final redline + memo to eng-legal@cloudtau.com (expected Wed 09/29).
- CloudTau legal to respond within 72 hours (by Mon 10/05) per our request.
- If accepted, we target signature and pilot ramp on 2026-10-12.

Appreciate the collaboration —
Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
